citation: Alhammad et al. 2026. Psychophysiological effects of traditional cycling, virtual reality-enhanced cycling, and passive virtual reality exposure in young adults: A controlled within-subject study. PLOS One
protocol: Seated rest 10 min; traditional cycling 10 min at 60-70 rpm, resistance level 5; VR cycling; passive VR; 10-min seated rests between sessions
note: Seated rest RR is the usable value (15.4 +/- 2.6 bpm at baseline). Cycling intensity is not stated in watts or %VO2max, so the exercise values are of limited use; a caveat for the reader.
